messages:
maria (Marketing): Hey team — I uploaded an early draft of the product launch blog to Drive: https://drive.redwood/release-draft. Need quick alignment on three items before comms: 1) primary audience hooks (startup PMs vs infra/platform), 2) benchmark/pricing claim language (we need safe headlines), and 3) inbound routing for the webinar CTA. Can folks skim and flag blockers? :pray:

devon (Product): Skimming now. High-level thought: lead with latency + cost benchmarks for infra folks but include a 2-3 line TL;DR for PMs that calls out faster shipping and integration. We should map two lead flows.

ajay (Growth): Agreed on two flows. For HubSpot we can use a single form but populate a hidden field for segment. Suggested hidden-field mapping below.

sam (Design): If we pivot hero messaging between infra and PM, I should produce two hero variants and a header CTA that swaps based on URL param.

eli (Legal): Quick note: avoid absolutes like "cheapest" or unqualified "lowest latency". If you include numbers, cite the benchmark doc and include methodology (model, seq len, hardware). Also clarify Dedicated/Private results may differ.

maria (Marketing): Good catches. ajay — drop the HubSpot snippet here? devon — please propose the PM TL;DR (2-3 lines) and the specific benchmark copy we can safely use. eli — we'll add citation links and a short disclaimer.

ajay (Growth): HubSpot snippet (single form, segment hidden field): ```html
<form action=\"https://forms.hubspot.com/submit/12345\">
  <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"lead_source\" value=\"launch-blog-2026\">
  <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"audience_segment\" value=\"__SEG__\"> <!-- PM or INFRA -->
  <input name=\"email\" type=\"email\"/>
  <button type=\"submit\">Reserve spot</button>
</form>
```
Use URL param `?seg=pm` or `?seg=infra` to set __SEG__. We'll route on that server-side.

maria (Marketing): Perfect — one form keeps analytics clean. Routing: seg=pm -> list_launch_pm + PM nurture; seg=infra -> list_launch_infra + infra whitepaper. ajay, can you add workflow IDs?

ajay (Growth): Workflow IDs: PM -> wf_991_PM_launch; Infra -> wf_991_INFRA_launch. I'll tag signups with "launch_2026_batchA" and queue a 24h nurture. Also can flip CTA copy when capacity is low.

devon (Product): Proposed PM TL;DR: "Ship LLM features faster — Redwood removes serving friction so product teams ship production-ready prompts, routing, and monitoring in days, not months." Proposed benchmark claim (infra): "On representative production workloads, Redwood reduces per-token latency by up to 25% vs standard A100 baseline and lowers per-request GPU cost by up to 30% (internal benchmark, May 2026)." Eli — ok if we reference a dated benchmark doc and methodology?

eli (Legal): That phrasing is acceptable if you link to the benchmark and include methodology. Replace vague "representative" with a short parenthetical about the workload cohort or keep as-is if methodology covers it. Also add a disclaimer: results may vary by workload and deployment.

maria (Marketing): Devon — update the doc to include: "reduces per-token latency by up to 25% vs standard A100 baseline and lowers per-request GPU cost by up to 30% (see benchmark methodology)." We'll add a small methodology box and a 1-line disclaimer under the claim.

devon (Product): Done — added "How we tested" box listing model family, sequence length distribution, batching strategy, and hardware used.

sam (Design): Note: webinar seats = 250 total. ajay, can you put a capacity check so the CTA swaps to "Join waitlist" at 230 registrations? I can also make the CTA visually distinct when waitlist is active.

ajay (Growth): Yes. I'll set seat_threshold=230 and hard_cap=250 in the registration service; launch-bot can post progress to #marketing. We'll swap CTA via CMS when threshold reached.

launch-bot: Configured registration thresholds: seat_threshold=230, hard_cap=250. Will post updates at 200, 230, and when full.

maria (Marketing): Eli — any final redlines on pricing/benchmark copy?

eli (Legal): Fine pending: 1) benchmark doc link included in copy, 2) baseline explicitly named as "standard A100 baseline (see methodology)", 3) disclaimer under claim stating results vary and not guaranteed. Remove wording implying guaranteed cost savings for all customers.

maria (Marketing): I'll add: "Results from internal benchmarks; your mileage may vary depending on workload and deployment mode."

sam (Design): I'll upload two hero variants and the header CTA that switches via ?seg=. ETA ~3 hours; will include a small table asset for the blog that maps hero variant to audience.

devon (Product): One last request: add a small table mapping feature -> target buyer. Suggest rows: Observability & rollouts -> PMs; Dedicated capacity -> infra/platform; Private deployments -> regulated enterprises. That will help the marketing site route messaging.

maria (Marketing): Love it. I'll fold all edits and re-upload the draft by EOD. If there are no major blockers we can hand to comms for copy lock tomorrow morning. :rocket:
